matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR converges roughly ten times faster than the original DETR while achieving better detection performance, particularly on small objects.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR achieves better performance than DETR with 10 times less training epochs.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR replaces dense attention with deformable attention modules that attend to a small set of sampling points per query, reducing computational complexity.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR's attention modules attend to a small set of key sampling points around a reference.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Multi-scale deformable attention naturally handles small objects efficiently without resorting to a separately constructed multi-scale feature pyramid head.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The deformable attention module is inspired by deformable convolution.
